description: A next-generation, carbon fiber manual wheelchair. Built to adapt, the Bowhead Era combines sleek design and unparalleled functionality to create the ultimate mobility solution. Our wheelchair is intended to be your steadfast companion, evolving with you through every phase of your life.

components.description: Our system allows you to easily remove the entire seat in one motion.
Titanium Torsion bar provides vibration and minor impact relief
Made of Carbon Fiber and seamlessly sleek. With durability to match that of downhill mountain bikes
Designed for high use areas to protect your chair and your walls.
Configuration 1: 5’’ MBL wheel with hub (plastic/composite); Configuration 2: 4’’ Bowhead 7s hubless wheel (Aluminum)
High strength and corrosion resistant, black
On-the-Fly angle adjustment backrest with sling backrest included. Standard backrest pivot tubes support mounting nearly any third party backrest to accommodate personal preference.

Seat Width - Adjustable: 13"-20.5" (33 cm - 52 cm); Seat Depth - Modular: 14” (35.6 cm), 16” (40.6 cm), or 18” (45.7 cm); Seat-to-Floor Height - Adjustable: 16.8” to 23.3” (42.6 cm - 59.2 cm); Seat Angle - Modular: 3°, 5°, 7°, 9°, 11° or 13°; Camber - Modular: 0° or 2°; Backrest Angle - Adjustable: 80° to 100°; COG (Center of Gravity) - Adjustable: 4” / 10.2 cm; Wheelbase - Adjustable: Standard: 14”-16”, Long: 17”-19”

Frame Material: Carbon Fiber; Maximum Weight Capacity: 242lbs / 110kg (with all accessories and personal items included); Ground Clearance: Wing 1: 85mm, Wing 2: 110mm, Wing 3: 136mm, Wing 4: 162mm; Rear Wheel Size: 559/25”; Coming soon - 540/24” and 584/27”; Caster Wheel Size: 7s: 4’’ or MBL: 5’’; Please note that individual wheelchairs will have unique specifications due to custom configuration ensuring proper fit and function. For instance, the overall width, length, and weight of the chair will change depending on various factors including but not limited to wheel size, tire type, camber and hand rim selection.
